{{short description|Russian mathematician}}
[[File:Batyrev victor.jpg|thumb|Victor Batyrev, [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] 2006]]
'''Victor Vadimovich Batyrev''' (Виктор Вадимович Батырев, born 31 August 1961, Moscow)<ref>Jahrbuch der Heidelberger Akademie der Wissenschaften 2010</ref> is a Russian mathematician, specializing in [[algebraic geometry|algebraic]] and [[arithmetic geometry]] and its applications to [[mathematical physics]]. He is a professor at the [[University of Tübingen]].

== Biography ==
Batyrev studied mathematics from 1978 to 1985 at [[Moscow State University]]. From 1991 he was at the [[University of Essen]], where he earned his [[habilitation]] in 1993. Since 1996 he has been a professor at the University of Tübingen.<ref>[https://www.math.uni-tuebingen.de/arbeitsbereiche/algebra/personen/prof-dr-victor-batyrev homepage of Victor Batyrev at the University of Tübingen]</ref>

He received in 1994 the Gottschalk-Diederich-Baedeker Prize. In 1995 he received the Heinz Maier-Leibnitz Prize for his habilitation thesis ''Hodge Theory of Hypersurfaces in Toric Varieties and Recent Developments in Quantum Physics''. In 1998 he was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in Berlin and gave a talk ''Mirror Symmetry and Toric Geometry''.<ref>{{cite book|author=Batyrev, Victor V.|chapter=Mirror symmetry and toric geometry|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. II|year=1998|pages=239–248|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011659000}}</ref> In 2003 he was elected a member of the [[Heidelberger Akademie der Wissenschaften]].<ref>[http://www.ub.uni-heidelberg.de/helios/fachinfo/www/math/akademie/batyrev.htm page for Batyrev at homepage of Heidelberger Akademie der Wissenschaften]</ref>
